description: Re-read the configuration files (config.json + conf.d/*.json, or --config <file>) into the running server, so connections and tunnels added or edited on disk become usable WITHOUT a restart. Open pools and running tunnels are never touched: they keep their previous definition until they are closed (idle timeout, down_tunnel, shutdown) and are reported in "warnings". Returns the files that were read plus the connections/tunnels added, removed and changed. On an invalid config nothing is swapped — the server keeps running on the previous configuration and the validation errors are returned.
name: config_reload
